model_annotation: This plot illustrates the relationship between co-occurrence number and accuracy (ACC) across six different conditions. The x-axis is labeled “Co-occurrence Number” and utilizes a logarithmic scale with a range of 1 to 1000. The tick labels are regularly spaced powers of 10, from 10 to 1000. The y-axis is labeled “ACC (%)” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 65, with tick labels at 5% intervals. The plot contains six lines: a black solid line labeled “Base,” which starts at approximately 38.2% and increases to approximately 52.6% along the x-axis; a blue solid line labeled “FT,” starting at approximately 38.8% and rising to around 51.1%; a red dashed line labeled “IKE,” beginning at roughly 44.4% and increasing to around 49.8%; a magenta dashed line labeled “MEMIT,” starting at approximately 46.6% and increasing to around 51.8%; a dark green line with triangular markers labeled “ROME,” starting at approximately 50.3% and increasing to approximately 64.1%; and a purple line with square markers labeled “MEND,” which begins at approximately 44.1% and increasing to around 50.1%.
